description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje pallat pa ashensor ne zonen e Bllokut, konkretisht prane Restorant Juvenilja.
Pallati eshte i vitit 2002 pa ashensor.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5te.
Lartesia e apartamentit shkon deri ne 3.40metra
organizohet:
1 sallon i bollshem me ambientin e gatimit te vecuar
2 dhoma gjumi
1 tualet me dritare
1 ballkon
1 korridor shpendares
Apartamenti eshte me certifikate pronesie
title_en: 2+1 apartment in the block for sale!
description_en: The apartment is located in a building without an elevator in the Blloku area, specifically near Juvenilja Restaurant. The building is from 2002 without an elevator. The apartment is located on the 5th floor. The height of the apartment is up to 3.40 meters, it is organized: 1 spacious living room with a separate cooking area, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom with window, 1 balcony, 1 corridor, the apartment has ownership certificates.
